justification: New satellite pipeline (terrain analysis) + integration into intelligence brief. No DB writes, no user-facing text beyond disclaimer. 7 files changed/added.

pre_impl.existing_data: No DB interaction. DEM data fetched from GA WCS + SIX Maps (HTTP). Intelligence brief adds terrain as optional satellite section.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If GA WCS endpoint changes format or goes offline: SIX Maps fallback. If both fail: terrain section shows NOT_AVAILABLE, brief continues.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New pipeline only. Existing intelligence briefs unaffected unless include_satellite=true.

functions.name: fetch_dem_region
functions.input: float lat, float lng, float buffer_m — from intelligence brief orchestrator
functions.output: io.BytesIO containing GeoTIFF — consumed by terrain_analysis._run_terrain_chain
functions.if_none: Raises RuntimeError, caught by _safe_call in intelligence_brief

functions.name: run_terrain_analysis
functions.input: float lat, float lng, bool include_flood — from _fetch_terrain in intelligence_brief
functions.output: dict with terrain/flood_susceptibility keys — consumed by _build_terrain_detail
functions.if_none: Returns TerrainResponse with error field set; _build_terrain_detail returns None

functions.name: _build_terrain_detail
functions.if_none: Returns None when input is None, DataField confidence=NOT_AVAILABLE in SatelliteData

functions.name: _fetch_terrain
functions.input: float lat, float lng — from orchestrator

values.if_missing: Terrain section shows NOT_AVAILABLE in brief, no crash

values.guard_at: intelligence_brief.py:1378 — confidence=NOT_AVAILABLE if terrain_detail is None

break_it.scenario: GA WCS returns valid HTTP 200 but with XML error body (not TIFF)
break_it.what_happens: _is_tiff check fails, falls back to SIX Maps, terrain still works
break_it.how: dem_service.py:111,134 — _is_tiff validates magic bytes before accepting response
break_it.repro: monkeypatch requests.get to return XML with 200 status — assert fallback triggers

break_it.scenario: whitebox tool returns non-zero exit code (corrupt DEM, missing binary)
break_it.what_happens: _run_tool raises RuntimeError, caught by try/except in run_terrain_analysis — TerrainResponse.error set
break_it.how: terrain_analysis.py:197-202 — _run_tool checks return code; terrain_analysis.py:260 catches and returns error response
break_it.repro: Mock whitebox slope to return 1 — assert RuntimeError raised

break_it.scenario: DEM raster has all NoData values (ocean, outside coverage)
break_it.what_happens: numpy operations on all-NaN array: nanmean=NaN, min/max=NaN — terrain detail has None values
break_it.how: terrain_analysis.py uses np.nanmean/nanmin/nanmax which return NaN for all-NaN input; _aspect_to_compass handles NaN as flat
break_it.repro: Would need rasterio integration test with synthetic all-nodata TIFF

post_merge.manual_verify: POST /pipeline/terrain-analysis with Sydney coordinates to verify live DEM fetch
